headline: Mexico’s Sheinbaum and Canada’s Carney Reaffirm Support for USMCA
summary: Mexican and Canadian leaders meeting in China reaffirmed their support for the USMCA trade agreement, contrasting with mixed signals from Washington.
why: Bilateral trade pact reaffirmations provide policy visibility for North American supply chains and multinational manufacturing investments.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Reaffirming support for the USMCA stabilizes trade expectations across North American markets.
